problems.reason: The Severn Formation is in England, not Maryland, so the sentence incorrectly associates it with a location that is not the animal’s habitat.

The genus is stated to have existed from the Kimmeridgian (late Jurassic) to the Maastrichtian (end of Cretaceous), yet species C. alhaulfi is reported from the Barremian (early Cretaceous), which predates the earliest age given for the genus.
